LLMs Are Not Strong Abstract Reasoners

description.en: A suite of abstract-reasoning tasks (IJCAI 2024), several of them text encodings of visual puzzles such as ARC, ACRE and RAVEN, plus PVR and tasks drawn from OpenAI Evals. A text-encoded ARC score is not comparable with a visual ARC score, and the source puzzles are public, so contamination cannot be ruled out.
